discovery.title: Aerial maps reveal successful woodland expansion in Scotland's Cairngorms
discovery.summary: A University of Cambridge–led team has used aerial surveys across a huge swath of the Cairngorms National Park in Scotland to create detailed 3D maps that show the beginnings of large-scale recovery of native woodland.
